WITH s AS (
  SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(r.sr_return_amt)
     FROM s JOIN store_returns r
       ON s.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number
      AND s.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk) AS return_amt,
  (SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) FROM s) AS net_paid,
  ROUND(
    (SELECT SUM(r.sr_return_amt)
       FROM s JOIN store_returns r
         ON s.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number
        AND s.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk)
    / (SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) FROM s) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year=2002 AND d.d_moy=9) AS sept_sales_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_sales ss WHERE ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL) AS total_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk FROM store_sales) x) AS distinct_ticket_item,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store_returns r JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_ticket_number=r.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk=r.sr_item_sk JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year=2002 AND d.d_moy=9) AS matched_return_rows;
